During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] [[Ydra Kilwallen Sibwarra|Ydra Kilwallen]] '''married''' a man, and took his last name '''Sibwarra'''. Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of G'rho]], Ydra was on vacation at her [[Parent/Legends|parents]]' when one of her fellow [[Force Adept]]s went missing on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. She took their son, [[Dev Sibwarra|Dev]], and left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She feared what the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] would do to them if they found her, and in her haste did not contact her husband before leaving.
